IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'RuleResult_bak') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[RuleResult_bak]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [EffectiveDate] [datetime] NOT NULL, [RowsPassed] [int] NOT NULL, [RowsFailed] [int] NOT NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_RuleResult_CreatedOn] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_RuleResult_CreatedBy] DEFAULT (0) NULL, [RunDate] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_RuleResult_RunDate] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NOT NULL, [RuleImplementationID] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_RuleResult_RuleImplementationID] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [PassFraction] AS (case when [RowsPassed]=(0) AND [RowsFailed]=(0) then (0) else CONVERT([decimal](18,17),CONVERT([decimal](18,3),[RowsPassed],(0))/(CONVERT([decimal](18,3),[RowsPassed],(0))+CONVERT([decimal](18,3),[RowsFailed],(0))),(0)) end), [FailFraction] AS (case when [RowsPassed]=(0) AND [RowsFailed]=(0) then (0) when [RowsPassed]=(0) AND [RowsFailed]<>(0) then (1) else CONVERT([decimal](18,17),CONVERT([decimal](18,15),CONVERT([decimal](18,3),(1),(0))-CONVERT([decimal](18,3),[RowsPassed],(0))/(CONVERT([decimal](18,3),[RowsPassed],(0))+CONVERT([decimal](18,3),[RowsFailed],(0))),(0)),(0)) end), [Passed] [decimal](18,17), CONSTRAINT [PK_RuleResult] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_RuleResult_RuleImplementation') BEGIN IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'RuleImplementation_bak') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[RuleResult_bak] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_RuleResult_RuleImplementation] FOREIGN KEY([RuleImplementationID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[RuleImplementation_bak] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[RuleResult_bak] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_RuleResult_RuleImplementation] END END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_RuleResult_RuleImplementationID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_RuleResult_RuleImplementationID] ON [dbo].[RuleResult_bak] ( [RuleImplementationID] ASC ) END
